title: OKS Evidence Locator v0.1
description: Minimal structural contract for evidence locators. Each evidence record in a Raw Bundle carries a locator that pinpoints where the evidence came from inside an artifact. This schema defines the required fields per locator kind so downstream consumers (AgentObservation, Candidate) can reliably resolve artifact_id + locator to a specific position in source material.

kind.description: Locator structural kind — determines which additional fields are required.

total_pages.description: Total page count of the artifact. Optional with kind=page.

region.description: Optional human-readable region label within a page (e.g. 'header', 'table', 'embedded-image', 'body').

bbox.description: Bounding box [x1, y1, x2, y2] in pixel coordinates. Required when kind=bbox.

bbox_page.description: 1-indexed page that contains this bbox. Optional with kind=bbox.

start_ms.description: Start time in milliseconds. Required when kind=timestamp.

end_ms.description: End time in milliseconds. Required when kind=timestamp.

text_hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the referenced text span. Optional, for integrity verification.

xpath_fragment.description: Minimal XPath or CSS selector fragment. Required when kind=dom.

dom_snapshot_index.description: 0-based index into a DOM snapshot array. Optional with kind=dom.

document_section.description: Section heading or paragraph offset within a document. Optional with kind=document.

custom_label.description: Free-form locator label. Required when kind=custom.
